title: The maintenance surface is not the model
caption: Sculley et al.'s audit of production ML systems: a mature system ends up at most ~5% machine-learning code and ~95% glue — integration wrappers, configuration, collection and serving plumbing. Debt accumulates in the 95%.

title: Daily cost vs retraining interval
caption: Amortized run cost + accrued staleness per day for the ranking service (C_r = \$5,000, Q = 1M/day, v = \$0.50, A₀ = 0.94, δ = 0.24%/day). The sum bottoms out near T* ≈ 3 days; shorter intervals overspend on runs, longer ones bleed staleness.

title: Four weeks of silent accuracy decay
caption: The ranking service's click accuracy, modeled at 0.24%/day decay: 94% → ~88% over four weeks while uptime, latency and error rate stay green. The signature is gradual — visible to a trend monitor, invisible to every health check.
